cover_letter.greeting: Dear JPMorgan Capital Markets Business Management Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Americas Capital Markets Business Management Associate role at JPMorgan Chase. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Having worked at the firm as a consultant, I know how much depends on reporting that leaders can trust, and this role sits close to the people who rely on it.

At JPMorgan Asset Management I worked on budget allocation across marketing channels. I benchmarked past allocations, which identified 30% in efficiency gains, and prepared executive-level briefs for senior leadership. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses on capital allocation that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and ran variance analyses on budget changes. At Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region.

That maps to the P&L and headcount reporting, forecast tracking and competitor benchmarking in this role. I haven't worked on a capital markets desk or used Dealogic, and I don't have deal experience, so the product side would be new to me. I'd bring the ability to make the numbers tie, keep several deadlines moving, and work well with bankers, controllers and compliance. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
